title: पूर्वीय अर्थ चिन्तन र नेपाली भाषा शिक्षण Purviya Artha Chintan ra Nepali Bhasha Shikshan
nepali: प्रस्तुत आलेख पूर्वीय अर्थ चिन्तन र नेपाली भाषा शिक्षण शीर्षकमा केन्द्रित रहेको छ । पूर्वीय अर्थ चिन्तनको प्रारम्भ कसरी भयो ? कुन कुन पक्षहरूले पूर्वीय अर्थ चिन्तनलाई समृद्ध तुल्याएका छन् ? ती चिन्तनहरूका मुख्य मान्यताहरू के के हुन् ? यसको चिन्तन परम्परा कसरी विकास भएको छ ?जस्ता प्राज्ञिक जिज्ञासाहरूको समाधानमा यस आलेखको औचित्यता प्रकट भएको छ । प्रस्तुत आलेखकोउद्देश्य परिपूर्ति गर्नका लागि गुणात्मक अनुसन्धान विधिको अवलम्बन गरिएको छ । सामग्री सङ्कलन गर्न द्वितीयक स्रोतअन्तर्गत पुस्तकालय कार्यबाट यस अध्ययनसँग सम्बन्धित पूर्ववर्ती विद्वान्हरूले अध्ययन विश्लेषण गरेका सामग्रीहरूको उपयोग गरिएको छ । संस्कृत परम्परामा शब्दार्थ सम्बन्धकाबारेमा भए गरेका दार्शनिक चिन्तनहरू वर्तमान भाषिक चिन्तनमा पनि उपयोगी रहेको र यसले नेपाली भाषा शिक्षणमा सकारात्मक प्रभाव पारेको निष्कर्ष यस आलेखको रहेको छ ।
american_english: The present article is focused on the title "Eastern Semantic Thought and Nepali Language Teaching." How did Eastern semantic thought originate? Which aspects have enriched Eastern semantic thought? What are the main tenets of those thoughts? How has its tradition of thought evolved?—the justification of this article is manifested in resolving such academic inquiries. To fulfill the objective of the present article, a qualitative research method has been adopted. To collect material, under secondary sources through library work, materials studied and analyzed by earlier scholars relevant to this study have been utilized. The conclusion of this article is that the philosophical reflections carried out regarding word-meaning relations in the Sanskrit tradition are useful in contemporary linguistic thought as well, and that this has exerted a positive impact on Nepali language teaching.

Which facets have enriched Eastern semantic thought? What are the primary assumptions of those thoughts? How has its tradition of thought developed?—the rationale of this article is demonstrated in addressing such academic inquiries. To fulfil the objective of the present article, a qualitative research method has been adopted. To collect material, under secondary sources through library work, materials studied and analysed by preceding scholars relevant to this study have been used. The conclusion of this article is that the philosophical deliberations conducted regarding the word–meaning relation in the Sanskrit tradition remain useful in contemporary linguistic thought too, and that this has exerted a positive influence on Nepali language teaching.
